headline: Approved Library Director's contract for 2026-2029 and February 24, 2026 meeting minutes
summary: The board reviewed the FY2026 and FY2027 budgets, discussed Marblehead's risk of library decertification, and heard updates on building and vehicle repairs including the HVAC project and bookmobile garage door. The board also covered collections, community engagement events, and programs. The board approved the Library Director's contract for 2026-2029.
decisions: Accepted the minutes of the meeting of February 24, 2026, as amended. Motion passed 7-0.
Approved the Library Director's contract for 2026-2029. Motion passed 7-0.
